title: headcount-sync-1on1-hiring-prep-scratchpad
content:
Context:
- Prep notes for 1:1 with Ben (hiring manager) + weekly headcount sync follow-up. Quick scratchpad so I don’t forget asks and blockers.
- Current focus: fill backend-engineer (BE-4), infra-ml (IML-2 senior), and ux-research (UXR-1) for Q1–Q2.

Meeting goals:
- Confirm hiring priorities & any scope changes for the three roles above.
- Get clarity on interview loop updates, outstanding debriefs, and offer approvals.
- Agree next steps for candidate pipeline (referrals, sourcer allocation, timeline).

Attendees (planned):
- Ben Marshall (hiring manager, eng-infra)
- Maya Thompson (People Ops)
- optionally: Ethan (recruiter) if we need to talk offers/comp comps

Background notes (to remind me):
- BE-4: strong pipeline but slow loop; 5 active candidates, 2 onsite scheduled. Concern: loop takes 3+ weeks on average.
- IML-2 (senior infra-ml): 2 candidates in final interview stage; hiring manager wants to prioritize senior offers if comp fits.
- UXR-1: low pipeline, need to tap referrals + outreach. Role was opened later; owner willing to flex on level if timeline matters.

Key metrics (quick):
- Open reqs this team: 9 (3 priority)
- Time-to-offer (team avg): 41 days
- Offer acceptance rate (last 6 months): 78%
- Hiring capacity (recruiter Ethan): +1 req this month if reprioritized

Prep questions for Ben (my talking points):
1) Confirm the priority ranking: BE-4 > IML-2 > UXR-1? Any changes if a strong IML candidate appears?
2) Are interviewers available to compress loop for BE-4? Which blockers (calendars, rubric disagreements)?
3) For IML-2, what's the comp ceiling? Any wiggle room for equity? Who signs off on total comp?
4) UXR-1: open to hiring an L3 generalist instead of L4 senior to speed timeline? Impact on scope?
5) Are there internal candidates we should prioritize or convert from contractors?
6) Any upcoming team projects that change capacity or affect start dates?

Notes to self / nudges during the meeting:
- Ask Ben to flag any 'must-hire by' dates for project planning — e.g., infra rollout in May.
- Offer approvals: remind him that approvals for total comp > $280k require VP sign-off (see hiring policy).
- If loop respondents are slow, propose: 1) shorter panel (remove optional interview), 2) asynchronous take-home + 1 live, 3) recruiter pre-briefs 24–48h earlier.

Interview loop status (per role) — quick bullets to verify in meeting:
- BE-4:
  - Stage: onsite scheduled for Mar 4 & Mar 6 (two candidates)
  - Interviewers: Sasha (backend), Priya (system design), Tom (product), Ben (manager)
  - Open issues: Priya flagged unclear rubric for scale question (need clarification).
  - Action ask: Can we get rubric update by end of week so feedback is consistent?
- IML-2:
  - Stage: final take-home submitted; panel scheduled next week
  - Interviewers: Arjun (infra-ml lead), Mei (applied-ml), Ben
  - Open issues: comp approval pending (talent partners)
  - Action ask: confirm comp band and get TA approval by Thu if possible.
- UXR-1:
  - Stage: sourcing only (0 pipeline)
  - Action ask: allocate 4 hours of sourcer time, push referral ask to product + design channels, consider contract-to-hire.

Potential blockers & mitigating actions:
- Blocker: interviewer availability causing >2-week scheduling lag.
  Mitigation: propose dedicated interview block next Wed/Thu (Ben to confirm).
- Blocker: comp approvals taking too long.
  Mitigation: expedite via David (Dir of People Ops) for critical finalists; provide comp benchmarking doc in meeting.
- Blocker: low pipeline for UXR-1.
  Mitigation: open permissive level range (L3–L4), temp contractor hire, or tap agency shortlist (cost tradeoffs discussed).

Decisions needed from Ben in 1:1:
- Approve temporary re-prioritization of recruiter capacity to BE-4/IML-2.
- Confirm comp ceiling for IML-2 and authorization path.
- Decide whether to open UXR role as L3–L4 or hire contract.

Ask list (actionable asks I will make):
- Ben: sign-off to reallocate one full day of Ethan for next 2 weeks to BE-4 + IML-2. (If yes, follow-up with calendar invite).
- Ben: confirm final interviewer list and availability windows for onsite next week.
- Ben: grant permission to present comp recommendation to David if candidate advance to offer.

Debrief action items (for after the meeting) — write as tasks to move into board:
- [ ] Update BE-4 interview rubric (owner: Priya) — due: 2026-03-03
- [ ] Request comp approval path for IML-2 (owner: Maya) — due: 2026-02-29
- [ ] Add 4h sourcer allocation for UXR-1 (owner: Ethan) — due: 2026-03-02
- [ ] Schedule focused interview block and send calendar (owner: Ben) — due: 2026-03-01
- [ ] Post debrief template / feedback reminders to interviewers for consistent scoring (owner: Maya) — due: 2026-02-28

Follow-ups I need to send after the 1:1:
- Short email recap to Ben + cc Ethan summarizing decisions and attach comp benchmarking snapshot.
- Move tasks into HR tracker (Jira HIRE-342) and tag Ben + Priya for updates.
- Slack nudge to product/design for UXR referrals (message draft below).

Slack nudge draft:
"Hey product/design — heads up: we’re hiring a UXR (L3–L4 flexible) for infra product research. If you have referrals or contractors who can start quickly, please DM Ethan or me. We’re prioritizing interviews in the next 2 weeks. Thanks! — Maya"

Open questions / unresolved:
- Can we get temporary interview capacity from another team for the week of March 1? (ask Ben)
- Any constraints on start dates due to project timelines or budget cycles?

Quick timeline (ideal):
- Feb 28: comp path confirmed for IML-2
- Mar 1: focused interview block scheduled
- Mar 4–6: BE-4 onsite interviews
- Mar 8: debriefs + decision on BE-4
- Mar 10: offers processed (if green)

Notes to self: keep tone direct but collaborative; focus on removing blockers vs. re-arguing role scope. Save broader headcount strategy discussion for weekly sync (not 1:1).

End of scratchpad.
